summary: Frontend-only end-to-end regression on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). Desktop core flows all pass: age gate, homepage sections, WhyChooseUs (6 cards), nav (all 5 links), search, product cards, add-to-cart, cart drawer open/close, PDP (detail-add, qty +/-, COA modal, review-locked), Peptide Finder Quiz (3 steps -> result modal), Products catalogue (search/category/sort/count all render), Stack Builder tabs, footer, checkout page renders and all fields present. CRITICAL BUG discovered: clicking 'proceed-checkout-button' navigates to /checkout but the cart drawer overlay stays open and its full-viewport overlay intercepts pointer events, making the entire checkout form (including research-use-checkbox and place-demo-order-button) unclickable — this completely blocks the purchase flow for real users. Also mobile issues from iteration 8 are UNRESOLVED: scrollWidth=425px on 390px viewport (horizontal overflow) and hero h1 renders 95px wide x 289px tall (letter-per-line wrapping) because .hero-popular still overlaps hero copy on mobile.

ui_bugs.issue: In Layout (App.js line 92), onCheckout={()=>nav('/checkout')} does NOT close the drawer before navigating. Result: cart-drawer overlay (full width 1920px, full height 1080px) remains rendered on /checkout page and intercepts every pointer event. User cannot interact with any checkout form field. Reproduced deterministically on desktop.

Hero h1 bounding box is 95px x 289px — 'BIOTECH LIFE SCIENCES' still wraps one glyph per line. .hero-popular card continues to occupy the right side of the hero copy on mobile instead of stacking below. Same as iteration 8 — NOT FIXED.

Horizontal overflow persists: documentElement.scrollWidth=425 on 390 viewport. Offending elements identified via runtime probe: div.mobiletools (right=425) and an anchor tag (right=524) inside header/announcement area. Same as iteration 8 — NOT FIXED.

integration_issues.issue: Blocked entirely by cart-drawer overlay staying open post-navigation. Could not verify order-placed, verified-review unlock, or cart clearing on live URL.

action_items: CRITICAL: In /app/frontend/src/App.js line ~92, change `onCheckout={()=>nav('/checkout')}` to `onCheckout={()=>{setDrawer(false);nav('/checkout');}}` so drawer closes on navigate. Same for buy-now flow (add() function already calls setDrawer(true); when buy is true and it navigates, drawer must be closed for the destination page). Verify by adding a product and clicking Proceed to Checkout — the checkout form should be interactable immediately.

MOBILE: In App.css add @media (max-width:768px){.hero-popular{position:relative!important;top:auto;right:auto;width:100%;margin-top:16px;} .hero{display:flex;flex-direction:column;}} so hero-popular stacks below hero copy giving h1 full viewport width.

MOBILE: Add `html,body{overflow-x:hidden;max-width:100vw;}` safety net AND fix .mobiletools / announcement anchor with right>viewport (wrap or truncate the announcement strip text; ensure .mobiletools uses gap and shrink).
critical_code_review_comments: CartDrawer close-on-navigate: the same overlay-block bug will affect the Buy Now flow too (add() with buy=true triggers setDrawer(true) then nav('/checkout')). Both must close drawer on nav.

App.js is a single monolithic file with all components inline on ~1-line-per-component style (minified-looking source). File size and lack of separation is severely hurting maintainability — recommend splitting into /components/ modules.
Iteration 8's mobile action items were not addressed in this fork. Recommend running a visual mobile-only pass with a real 390px device profile before deploy.
Announcement/trust strip likely has fixed min-width or nowrap; needs responsive wrapping.

rca of the issue: Checkout-blocked bug RCA: In Layout component (App.js ~L92), onCheckout handler only calls navigate('/checkout') without setDrawer(false). React keeps the CartDrawer mounted because `drawer` state is still true, and its `.overlay.draweroverlay` div has fixed inset:0 covering the viewport (z-index above the form). Result: pointer-events pass to the overlay, not the form. Reproduction: 1) add any product to cart, 2) drawer opens, 3) click PROCEED TO CHECKOUT, 4) URL is /checkout but drawer overlay remains, 5) attempt to click any checkout field — Playwright reports 'div.overlay.draweroverlay intercepts pointer events'. Mitigation: 1-line change on Layout onCheckout to setDrawer(false) before nav. Same treatment required in add() when buy=true.
